storeApi.label: Cart and checkout
storeApi.outcome: not rebuilt: each product's Buy button is the product's external checkout link (field `buy_url`, filled in per product); /cart/ and /checkout/ answer 301 → the shop listing

storeApi.label: Customer accounts (my-account, login, registration)
storeApi.outcome: not rebuilt: /my-account/ and its sub-pages answer 301 → the shop listing; customers and their addresses are never migrated

storeApi.label: Orders, refunds, customers, store statistics
storeApi.outcome: never migrated (customer data stays in WordPress; export it there before it is switched off)

storeApi.label: Coupons
storeApi.outcome: not carried: apply discounts in the external checkout (Stripe Payment Links can take promotion codes)

storeApi.label: Payment gateways, tax and shipping settings
storeApi.outcome: not carried: they belong to the checkout the Buy button goes to

storeApi.label: Variable products
storeApi.outcome: shown with their price range ("from" the lowest price) and a table of their 2 variations (options, SKU, price, stock); the buyer picks the option at the checkout

storeApi.label: External / affiliate products
storeApi.outcome: kept as they are: the Buy button links to WordPress's product URL with its button text

storeApi.label: Stock tracking
storeApi.outcome: stock levels are not shown or counted; each product keeps its availability (in stock / out of stock / on backorder) as an editable field, also in the structured data

storeApi.label: Out-of-stock or backorder products
storeApi.outcome: migrated with their availability; the Buy button reads "Out of stock" and is not a link

storeApi.label: Products on sale
storeApi.outcome: regular and sale price both shown (the sale price is an editable field: clear it to end the sale)

storeApi.label: Product reviews and star ratings
storeApi.outcome: not migrated as reviews: no star ratings or review structured data on the new site (reviews the Exporter returned as comments follow the comments decision)

storeApi.label: Product attributes
storeApi.outcome: shown on the product page as a list (name: values); attribute archives (/pa_color/…) are not rebuilt

exporter.label: Cart and checkout
exporter.outcome: not rebuilt: each product's Buy button is a link to the contact form with the product's name prefilled; /cart/ and /checkout/ answer 301 → the shop listing

exporter.label: Customer accounts (my-account, login, registration)
